description: Sosta biciclette is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Milano. Posizione e caratteristiche delle aree di sosta riservate ai velocipedi Finalità Il dataset espone la mappa degli stalli per le biciclette, riportandone le caratteristiche strutturali e il numero di stalli a disposizione. La presenza capillare degli stalli favorisce lo sviluppo del traffico ciclistico nell'intera città. Coverage: Comune di Milano. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Milano. Its tags are geo, georeferenziatocsv, municipio, tpl. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
